# 3D Template

3D graphics template with OpenGL.

## Create

```bash
nexus new My3D --template 3d
cd My3D
nexus build
nexus run
```

## Structure

```
My3D/
├── nexus.toml
├── src/
│   ├── main.nx       # App entry
│   ├── camera.nx     # Camera controller
│   ├── mesh.nx       # Mesh loading
│   ├── shader.nx     # Shaders
│   └── scene.nx      # Scene graph
├── assets/
│   ├── models/
│   ├── textures/
│   └── shaders/
└── tests/
```

## Features

- **Camera**: FPS-style (WASD + mouse)
- **Meshes**: Cube, sphere, plane, loaded models
- **Shaders**: Basic PBR, unlit, debug
- **Lighting**: Directional, point, spot
- **Textures**: Diffuse, normal, roughness
- **Input**: Keyboard + mouse look

## Camera Controller

```nx
// src/camera.nx
struct Camera {
    position: vec3,
    yaw: f32,   // Horizontal rotation
    pitch: f32, // Vertical rotation
    fov: f32,
    aspect: f32,
    near: f32,
    far: f32,
}

fn camera_update(cam: *Camera, dt: f32) {
    // Mouse look
    let sensitivity = 0.1
    cam.yaw   += input_mouse_delta_x() * sensitivity
    cam.pitch -= input_mouse_delta_y() * sensitivity
    cam.pitch = clamp(cam.pitch, -89.0, 89.0)
    
    // Keyboard movement
    let speed = 5.0 * dt
    let forward = vec3(cos(cam.yaw), 0, sin(cam.yaw))
    let right = vec3(-sin(cam.yaw), 0, cos(cam.yaw))
    
    if input_key_down(KEY_W) { cam.position += forward * speed }
    if input_key_down(KEY_S) { cam.position -= forward * speed }
    if input_key_down(KEY_A) { cam.position -= right * speed }
    if input_key_down(KEY_D) { cam.position += right * speed }
    if input_key_down(KEY_SPACE) { cam.position.y += speed }
    if input_key_down(KEY_SHIFT) { cam.position.y -= speed }
}

fn camera_view(cam: Camera) -> mat4 {
    let front = vec3(
        cos(cam.yaw) * cos(cam.pitch),
        sin(cam.pitch),
        sin(cam.yaw) * cos(cam.pitch)
    )
    mat4_look_at(cam.position, cam.position + front, vec3(0,1,0))
}

fn camera_proj(cam: Camera) -> mat4 {
    mat4_perspective(cam.fov, cam.aspect, cam.near, cam.far)
}
```

## Basic Shader

```glsl
// assets/shaders/basic.vert
#version 330 core
layout(location = 0) in vec3 aPos;
layout(location = 1) in vec3 aNormal;
layout(location = 2) in vec2 aTexCoord;

uniform mat4 uModel;
uniform mat4 uView;
uniform mat4 uProj;

out vec3 Normal;
out vec2 TexCoord;
out vec3 FragPos;

void main() {
    FragPos = vec3(uModel * vec4(aPos, 1.0));
    Normal = mat3(transpose(inverse(uModel))) * aNormal;
    TexCoord = aTexCoord;
    gl_Position = uProj * uView * vec4(FragPos, 1.0);
}
```

```glsl
// assets/shaders/basic.frag
#version 330 core
in vec3 Normal;
in vec2 TexCoord;
in vec3 FragPos;

out vec4 FragColor;

uniform vec3 uLightPos;
uniform vec3 uLightColor;
uniform vec3 uViewPos;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;

void main() {
    vec3 norm = normalize(Normal);
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(uLightPos - FragPos);
    float diff = max(dot(norm, lightDir), 0.0);
    vec3 diffuse = diff * uLightColor;
    
    vec3 viewDir = normalize(uViewPos - FragPos);
    vec3 reflectDir = reflect(-lightDir, norm);
    float spec = pow(max(dot(viewDir, reflectDir), 0.0), 32);
    vec3 specular = spec * uLightColor;
    
    vec3 color = texture(uTexture, TexCoord).rgb;
    vec3 result = (diffuse + specular) * color;
    FragColor = vec4(result, 1.0);
}
```

## Rendering Loop

```nx
while !gfx_should_close() {
    let dt = gfx_delta_time()
    input_poll_events()
    
    camera_update(&mut camera, dt)
    
    gfx_begin_frame()
    gfx_clear(0x1a1a2e)
    
    gfx3d_use_shader(shader)
    gfx3d_set_uniform_mat4(shader, "uProj", camera_proj(camera))
    gfx3d_set_uniform_mat4(shader, "uView", camera_view(camera))
    gfx3d_set_uniform_vec3(shader, "uLightPos", vec3(5, 10, 5))
    gfx3d_set_uniform_vec3(shader, "uViewPos", camera.position)
    gfx3d_bind_texture(0, texture)
    
    for entity in scene.entities {
        gfx3d_set_uniform_mat4(shader, "uModel", entity.transform)
        gfx3d_draw_mesh(entity.mesh)
    }
    
    gfx_end_frame()
}
```

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `WASD` | Move |
| `Space/Shift` | Up/Down |
| `Mouse` | Look around |
| `Escape` | Release cursor |
| `F1` | Toggle wireframe |
| `F2` | Toggle normals |
| `F3` | Toggle lights |
